articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Leading broadcaster plans dedicated Southern sports channel network
articles.summary: Industry sources reveal that regulatory approvals have been sought to launch regional sports feeds in Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada ahead of the premier league cycle.

articles.headline: Digital out-of-home screens in transit hubs see 35% surge in festive programmatic bookings
articles.summary: Airports and metro transit networks across Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru become preferred programmatic DOOH hubs for fintech and smartphone advertisers.

articles.headline: Fintech brands recalibrate customer acquisition strategies focusing on credit card rewards
articles.summary: With stricter regulatory norms on unsecured personal loans, neo-banks and payment aggregators shift marketing dollars toward co-branded credit card promotions.

articles.headline: Gaming creators in India capture higher brand spend as esports reaches mainstream audience
articles.summary: Non-endemic sponsors including beverage, automotive, and footwear brands increase their commitments to competitive live stream tournaments by 50%.

articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Titan Company plans major international retail expansion across Southeast Asia
articles.summary: The lifestyle and jewelry major will open 25 flagship Tanishq and Titan boutique stores in Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand supported by localized brand campaigns.

articles.headline: Publicis Groupe India wins integrated mandate for premier hospitality chain
articles.summary: Leo Burnett and Zenith will jointly handle brand transformation, performance marketing, and digital customer journeys for the luxury hotel group.

articles.headline: Radio industry records steady advertising volume growth driven by local retail and real estate
articles.summary: Tier-2 FM stations report strong festive inventories with real estate developers and consumer electronics accounting for over 30% of commercial airtime.

articles.headline: Amazon Ads India introduces zero-party data measurement tools for clean-room collaboration
articles.summary: Enterprise advertisers can now match first-party CRM profiles with retail browsing intent without exposing customer personal identifiable information.

articles.headline: Hero MotoCorp unveils high-voltage festive ad film celebrating regional Indian traditions
articles.summary: Crafted by Ogilvy India, the multi-film campaign highlights emotional homecoming moments across motorcycle and premium scooter lineups.

articles.headline: Women Disruptors 2026: Adgully announces jury panel and opening of nominations
articles.summary: The flagship initiative celebrating trailblazing women across advertising, media, PR, and digital marketing returns for its seventh edition in Mumbai.
